perks.name: The Dance
perks.description:
Moderately increases airborne effectiveness and hip fire mobility, range, and accuracy for weapons that use Primary ammo.

Final blows with Primary ammo weapons return dodge energy, which can overflow to create additional charges when full.

item.name: Weapons Font
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
While Armor Charge is active:

+20 | +40 | +50 Weapons.

item.name: Strand Scavenger
item.description: Strand weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
